violations.message: [Rule: no_wildcard_action] Statement (Sid: 'AllowAllActionsOnS3Bucket', Action: '*') permits wildcard (*) Action. Over-privileged access violates least privilege.

gemma_alone.threat_explanation: This policy grants full access to the 'production-financial-records' S3 bucket, allowing any action on it. This poses a significant risk as it grants unrestricted access to sensitive financial data. An attacker could potentially delete, modify, or read all data within the bucket, leading to financial loss or reputational damage. This policy is a major security vulnerability.
combination_risks: Unrestricted access to S3 bucket combined with the 'iam:PassRole' permission could allow an attacker to escalate privileges and gain control of the AWS account.
